name: att3-abench-filltok
command: for kv in 0 1; do for f in "" "--fill-tok"; do tmp/att3/abench_v10 --ctx 4096 --kv $kv --phases --reps 10 --thrash 64 $f | grep phases | sed "s/^/fill[$f] /"; tmp/att3/abench_v10 --ctx 4096 --kv $kv --stream-cols $f | grep stream | sed "s/^/fill[$f] /"; tmp/att3/abench_v10 --ctx 4096 --kv $kv --stream-alt $f | grep stream | sed "s/^/fill[$f] /"; done; done
